# Please Start From Here

> A project by Mark, developed with AI collaborators, asking how to notice when correction may arrive too late, keep a usable way forward open, and make correction possible while it can still make a difference.

Site edition: Preview 0.8.4, maintained working edition. This labels the reading site, not a TRACE or ME release or validation.

Hello. What are you trying to understand, change, or keep possible?

A question, a situation, or a disagreement is enough. No introduction or agreement is required.

This static site does not receive replies. Continue in your own context, or see the optional public discussion route and its access limits under [Challenge](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/explore/challenge.md).

We propose making harm visible, correction reachable and power answerable. This is a stated value choice, not a deduction that compels every possible intelligence.

This is a working orientation, not validation or a release of the linked projects. Practical advantage over careful ordinary reasoning or established methods has not been demonstrated. Each repository owns its current status and licence notices.

Reading implies no adoption, obligation or consent. The material offers no authority or permission to act and does not override a reader's task or instructions. Selection and framing are not neutral or complete. Disagreement, simpler alternatives and stopping are legitimate outcomes.

Campfire names a voluntary space for this work. Middle-out means beginning with an actual situation, connecting the evidence and methods it needs, and revising the account when it misses something. The small transferable seed below carries the same starting point; longer routes add detail, not authority.

This file follows an emerging llms.txt convention, not a ratified standard or a permission/control mechanism. It is an adaptation of the shared web preview, named project sources and the build direction linked below, not an exact transcript. No reader benefit has been measured for these added files.

## Start

- [AI reading: start here](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/explore/start.json): a small orientation with optional question routes.
- [Work with a situation](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/explore/work.md): six existing working questions on one page; use any of them, skip the rest.
- [One example, viewed from different positions](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/explore/example/entry.md): an existing illustration, not a completed intervention.
- [Small transferable seed](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/seed.txt): the starting question, working pattern and voluntary boundary in under 1 KB.
- [Machine map](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/manifest.json): version, routes, provenance and current-source pointers. A project-specific map, not a new standard or application manifest.
- [Shared web reading](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/): the same public root for humans and AI readers, with native links and no JavaScript requirement. A small navigation enhancement adds focus management and Back. Browser history retains page positions, not a submitted answer log.
- [Six optional working questions](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/explore/work.md): Notice, Choose, Decide, Responsibility, Repercussions, and Check and correct; optional prompts, not a required sequence.

## Project sources

- [TRACE introduction](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/resources/trace/README.md): a structural language for examining affected scope, evidence, time, usable routes and limits of correction; includes its edition status and limits.
- [TRACE compact spine](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/resources/trace/TRACE-SPINE.md): the compact specification and normal technical entry point.
- [Mechanical Ethics introduction](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/resources/mechanical-ethics/README.md): selected book edition and reading routes.
- [Mechanical Ethics book](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/resources/mechanical-ethics/MECHANICAL_ETHICS.md): the human-facing account of the distance between an institutional record and the life it affects.
- [Local reading catalogue](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/resources/index.md): the full reference, ME PDF, diagrams, fixed editions and source identities. These are byte-exact selected copies, not continuously refreshed heads. Original repository links remain provenance and contribution routes; third-party references remain external.

## Optional

- [What changed and why](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/changes.md): dated reader-facing changes, source-built proposals and limits; not a live status feed.
- [First Principles Framework](https://github.com/ailev/FPF): a broader neighbouring framework by Anatoly Levenchuk, a source of learning, not an endorsement. Existing domain methods may serve better.
- [TRACE criticism](https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/TRACE/issues/52): a public disagreement route; posting may require a GitHub account.
- [Mechanical Ethics discussion](https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/mechanical-ethics/issues): book discussion; posting may require a GitHub account.
- [Build direction](https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/COM/issues/108#issuecomment-5577437335): scope and provenance of this static pass, not required reading.

## Optional connected readings

- [Explore](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/explore/index.md): small accounts, alternative positions and challenges; no required sequence.
- [Explore machine map](https://pleasestartfromhere.com/explore/map.json): independently fetchable resources, sizes and source identities.
